card.name: Dose-related words in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Words in dosing instructions that come just before or inside an amount, such as 'dose', 'dosage', 'infusion time', a section number or a decimal. It also fires partway through drug and measuring-device names like Sulfate and milliliter.

modes.label: Dose wording
modes.description: The word dose, dosage or a nearby word in an instruction to reduce, measure or adjust a dose.
